reviews.classification: bounded source evidence and historical coverage reconciliation
reviews.disposition: Bodily condition, food, dice capacity, broken skills, medical access and corporate claims remain separate. Action clocks and cycle clocks have different causes. The 1,398 indexed Ink roots and bounded text windows do not establish complete story or executable graphs. Scene decoding failed and SERIALIZED_TEXT.json failed to write with Errno28; neither is recovered evidence. Exact dice odds, numerical transitions, save RNG and offline policy remain unknown.

Typed memories, separately retained endings and preparation callbacks remain optional original proposals. Unused Break-subopcode semantics, native VN dispatch/extensions, localization, reachability and runtime persistence remain unqualified. The later dated verified removal receipt supersedes the earlier unverified request within this historical dossier; neither is a fresh installation check.

reviews.classification: bounded source evidence and historical coverage reconciliation
reviews.disposition: Eleven app-owned wrapper entries and retained raw hashes support shell navigation/session observations. Source maps lack embedded sources; remote gameplay, territory, armies, economy, relationships and server persistence were not recovered. The five proposals and 22 touches are original YAIR options, not observed Eldyn mechanics. Historical DNS failure does not prove permanent shutdown. The uninstall request remains historically unverified and grants no fresh action authority.

ids: ARM/x86 candidate union; scalar repair; canonical flow/Heat updates
reviews.classification: bounded source evidence and historical coverage reconciliation
reviews.disposition: The October 7 coverage map and report predate the later checkpoint: the checkpoint records closed initial exports for both architectures (ARM 183,199 unique / 183,186 C / 13 failures; Intel 182,398 / 182,329 C / 69 failures), then canonical ARM flow refresh to 183,188 C / 11 failures. Preserve the old map/table as historical snapshots rather than silently treating their running-export status as live. The checkpoint also reports a later decoded union of 9,231,272; its ownership reconciliation and further Heat/hash/ABI/Intel work remain scoped open work, not a completed semantic audit. No old process/session ID is checked or resumed here. Candidate coverage, retained bytes, decoded addresses, generated C, bounded semantic claims and playable retort acceptance remain distinct. Scalar finite-case qualification does not establish NaN/FPCR/signed-zero fidelity; neither initial exports nor later repairs imply whole-game semantic coverage.
